newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladeshis protest U.S. missile attacks on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshis protest U.S. missile attacks on Iraq.

text.p: Hundreds of Bangladeshis on Thursday burned U.S. President Bill Clinton in effigy to protest American missile attacks on Iraq, witnesses said.

Organised by the small Bangladesh Patriotic Party, the protesters in Dhaka called for an immediate end to "American barbarity" against Iraqi people and urged the United Nations to punish "American hegemonists."
"Iraq is being made a scapecoat in Clinton's attempt to spruce up his sagging image ahead of the U.S. presidential election," one protester said.
"Such designs would not only provoke heroic resistence from Iraqi patriotic people but from peace-loving people around the world," another said.

The United States launched 44 cruise missiles against military targets in southern Iraq on Tuesday and Wednesday in retaliation for Baghdad's military incursion into areas of Kurdish-held northern Iraq at the weekend.
The government of mainly Moslem Bangladesh and its major opposition parties have not reacted to the raids.
